title: Tropical storm
tldr: Treat tropical storm warnings seriously: dangerous flooding, surge, wind and tornadoes can occur. Check local evacuation instructions, avoid flooded roads, and take shelter before conditions become unsafe.
steps: Check flood, surge and tornado notices as well as wind forecasts.
Charge devices, secure loose outdoor items while safe and arrange essential medicines and supplies.
Follow the evacuation zone and route instructions for your address.
Stay off roads during hazardous weather and never drive into floodwater.
next: Monitor updates after the storm passes; rivers may keep rising and power lines may remain live.
watch: A storm below hurricane strength can still cause catastrophic flooding.
